title: Nonreproducible root installation
detail: npm ci failed because the lockfile omitted a required lru-cache dependency. Repaired lock resolution; root clean install and Docker npm ci passed.
evidence: baseline install failure; repaired install and final-csp-docker-build

title: Type and generated-route failures
detail: Stale route generation plus invalid/narrow types and an incorrect Better Auth session call prevented type checking. Regenerated routes and corrected contracts without changing grants.

title: Empty test gate falsely succeeded
detail: The missing tests glob returned success with zero executed tests. Added nonempty discovery and real regression suites.
evidence: baseline-test; unit and integration passes listed below

title: Private portal pages accepted wrong hosts
detail: Application relied on ingress for page isolation. Baseline unknown Host and marketplace /admin returned200. Application now rejects unknown hosts and private paths on other portals. Resource authorization remains separate.

title: Sibling origin could mutate executive credentials
detail: Better Auth allowed every portal origin. A valid executive session and current password could change its password from the marketplace Origin. Added receiving-host Origin and Fetch-Metadata enforcement. This was not a passwordless takeover.

title: Signup rejected its newly created account
detail: Signup creates an unverified identity before requesting its code; the existence test rejected it. Only an already verified account now causes the duplicate signup error.

title: Email proof could commit without account verification
detail: OTP consumption and emailVerified update used separate commits. Fault injection stranded the account. Both now commit atomically and recheck expiry/identity.

title: Phone proof could commit without profile verification
detail: OTP consumption and profile confirmation were separate; selected adapter was not bound in claim SQL. Added atomic confirmation, consistent lock ordering, provider binding and expiry recheck.

title: Merchant writes could outlive failed audit persistence
detail: Create/edit/archive committed before audit insertion. Real PostgreSQL fault injection reproduced all three partial writes. Each mutation and its audit now share a transaction; edit row lock spans the update.

title: Missing migration checksums silently fabricated history
detail: Migrator stamped current checksums on historical rows with no proof. It now refuses unknown history and requests evidence-based reconciliation. No migration was edited or deleted.

title: Premature authentication navigation
detail: Better Auth callbackURL redirected before application-specific follow-up and routing. Removed redundant sign-in redirects across affected forms, retaining TOTP redirects. Provider password form now agrees with minimum length.

title: Unavailable SMS stranded merchant onboarding
detail: Application was saved but UI stayed on consumed email verification after SMS failure. Added honest pending-phone state, retry, status link and disabled verification without a challenge.

title: Rejected merchant forms erased input
detail: Action wrapper handled rejection but resolved its promise; unconditional then reset/close erased create/edit input. Removed those post-action handlers; successful writes already reload.

title: Scheduler could not reach host-isolated workers
detail: Private-network requests lacked configured Host and worker limits expected public forwarded identity. Requests now preserve configured Host with node:http and signed internal subject limits. HMAC/replay checks retained.

title: Scheduler idle ticks misreported health
detail: Five-minute beta cadence conflicted with per-minute health expectations; idle ticks erased failed work. Separate loop freshness and last completed run, preserving failures until successful work.

title: Idle database/cache connections retained shutdown
detail: Idle Redis socket and PostgreSQL pools held the event loop after HTTP shutdown. Unref idle socket and allow idle pools to exit; pending work remains awaited.

title: Optional push blocked beta builds
detail: Shared beta build demanded a push provider despite optional notifications. Permit both settings absent only for explicit beta/local; hide unavailable push UI and still reject mismatches.

title: Compose start sequencing did not prove readiness
detail: Added app and authenticated cache health, dependency readiness, scheduler grace and least-privilege app capabilities; limited scheduler secrets.

title: SSR errors erased the access-denied page
detail: Loader-error response lost nonce-bearing CSP headers. Browser blocked inline router bootstrap and replaced SSR message with blank content. Apply security headers to final response, preserving request nonce and response status.

title: Referenced discovery browser suite missing
detail: Restored advertised browser command with actual search/cart/mobile/API-boundary checks.

title: Executive moderation dashboard crashes on database dates
detail: Customer/product timestamp SQL returned Date objects while the API claimed strings; React rejected them and the authenticated dashboard displayed an access error. PostgreSQL regression reproduced object!=string. Explicit UTC text projection repairs the transport contract.
evidence: executive-browser-after-rate-window; moderation-date-baseline; moderation-date-fixed; final executive browser

title: Long audit IDs overflow the executive mobile dashboard
detail: Implicit mobile grid tracks expanded to the minimum width of unbroken audit identifiers. Explicit minmax(0,1fr) grid column and wrapping keep audit content readable within the viewport.

title: Mobile dependency security gate fails
detail: 35 affected packages:21high/14moderate, propagated from five advisory causes. Latest braces3.0.3 and node-forge1.4.0 still vulnerable. Nonbreaking audit fix did not resolve; no forced unsupported SDK change.

title: Existing database upgrade provenance unavailable
detail: 186 current migrations pass fresh/repeat/restore checks. Number0034 is absent and source history says0041/0105 were rewritten before this audit. No original artifacts provided; unknown upgrades cannot be certified.

title: Total executive factor-loss recovery not verified
detail: Unused TOTP recovery codes work and cannot be replayed. Loss of authenticator plus every recovery code lacks a verified audited recovery flow. No bypass introduced.

title: Face matching and spoof resistance unverified
detail: Experimental protocol/PAD tests do not validate real matching, liveness, camera or spoof resistance. Face login stays disabled in shared environments and device-independent in architecture.
